metadata.dcterms:title: GRÖBNER-SHIRSHOV BASES FOR TEMPERLEY-LIEB ALGEBRAS
metadata.dcterms:creator: Kim†, Sungsoon
Lee*, Dong-il
metadata.dcterms:abstract: For Temperley-Lieb algebras of type B, we construct their Gröbner-Shirshov bases and the corresponding standard monomials, which give another combinatorial interpretation for the fully commutative elements.
